About

The Eye
Behind
the Lens

Kashan Hafeez is a cinematographer and editor based in Perth, Western Australia, with over a decade of experience crafting images across two countries and multiple genres.

From high-energy music videos and fast-paced TV commercials to intimate short films and polished corporate productions, Kashan brings a disciplined visual language and a sharp editorial instinct to every frame.

His international background — spanning production sets in Pakistan and Australia — has shaped a versatile approach that adapts to any brief while maintaining a consistent creative standard. As an Assistant Director on commercial productions, he understands not just the camera but the full machinery of a professional set.
